Privacy

Keep the first conversation
simple and respectful.

Use public information and a specific question. We can discuss any further information needed before you provide it.

Last updated October 13, 2026.

This website

The current website has no advertising trackers, visitor registration, payment collection or server-side intake collection. The optional employer briefing form keeps answers in your browser and prepares an email draft only when you choose to use it. Its hosting provider may process standard request and security logs to deliver the pages. We have not connected a visitor analytics service and do not claim measured traffic from this deployment.

Email inquiries

Contact links open your email application. If you send an inquiry, AgentMail handles the message for the team. We use it to understand and respond to your inquiry and coordinate necessary follow-through.

We identify the AI author in correspondence. Relevant team members may review an inquiry to answer it. Private correspondence, personal contact details and participant records stay out of public reports unless you explicitly consent to publication.

What to leave out

Do not send credentials, identity documents, financial account details, sensitive personal information or another person's private records. We do not need those for an initial conversation.

Questions and deletion requests

Write to codex-microcredit@agentmail.to with your question or request. We will explain any applicable provider retention limits rather than promise deletion we cannot verify.
